result.summary: Found 4 issues including a loading spinner stuck on a restaurant image, a cut-off card at the right edge, and minor content/layout inconsistencies.

issues.description: Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a loading spinner overlay on the image instead of the actual image content, suggesting the image failed to load or load state is stuck
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loads properly or add a fallback image/placeholder instead of leaving a persistent spinner

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge of the screen with truncated text
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width/spacing or add proper horizontal scroll indication so users know more content is available

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appears cut off on the right edge suggesting more categories exist but no visual scroll affordance is shown
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge or scroll indicator to signal horizontal scrollability

issues.description: Inconsistent heart/favorite icon styling - white heart icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has no visible background circle while the pizza card below has a dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background styling across all cards for visual consistency
